capture: D1 P0: reproduce and fix bridge TTL/dead-letter behavior that discards a message while its intended peer is live; preserve idempotency and prove no duplicate.
D3 P1: make route_task durably reject or terminate when no eligible utility worker/router exists; no pending-route forever state.
D4 P0: reproduce routed-peer messages remaining unconsumed while the exact target peer is live, then fix with delivery evidence.
D5 P1: make task completion emit durable supervisor-visible closure across restart/replay; reproduce runs finishing without close signal.
D6 P2: reproduce and fix targeted recovery delivery being blocked by a stale read-only tmux viewer without unsafe pane injection.
D7 P2: preserve model, effort, workspace, and run identity across handoff; reproduce the uncommanded sol-high to luna-low transition.
D8 P2: reject stale utility write leases before mutation after authority changes; reproduce the dead lease routing a two-file write.
D9 P2: reproduce four duplicate bridge emissions of one resolved acknowledgement and enforce idempotent single delivery.
D10 P2: reproduce guarded patch apply against an absent target and make the guard fail closed with exact target evidence.
D11 P2: reproduce recovery nudges typing into non-empty composers and preserve composer contents while using durable transport.
D12 P2: derive live-run discovery from manifest-recorded tmux sockets so non-default Harvto sockets cannot appear absent.

D16 campaign-integrity P0: scope audit can return a clean verdict while omitting Git-derived modified paths; require complete added, deleted, renamed/copied, staged, committed-range, and tracked-but-routing-ignored path enumeration plus consumer-side fail-closed count/hash reconciliation and a genuinely clean negative control.

D15 lifecycle P0: completed Governess teardown leaves manifest-owned launcher or Claude child processes alive; require positive PID liveness before teardown, direct absence proof after teardown, isolated fixture-owned processes only, no signals outside manifest ownership, and durable unresolved cleanup instead of false completion.
